## Details

<a id="cursor_sprites_script"></a>
### [`cursor_sprites_script`](../../../../src/script/cursor_scripts.asm#L6) `$1AF8-$1B0B`

*data*

Script: sets the colour of all 8 sprites to black and the sprite pointers at $5ff8 to $60-$67 (sprite data $5800-$59ff). Then it continues into clear_cursor_script.

<a id="clear_cursor_script"></a>
### [`clear_cursor_script`](../../../../src/script/cursor_scripts.asm#L11) `$1B0C-$1B19`

*data*

Script: clears the sprite data at $5800-$58ff (sprites 0-3), clears the label sprites with script $2e60, and sets the destination to sprite 1 ($5840) for a brush cursor script.

<a id="brush_cursor_0"></a>
### [`brush_cursor_0`](../../../../src/script/cursor_scripts.asm#L15) `$1B1A-$1B32`

*data*

Brush cursor scripts: each draws the mark of one brush into sprite 1 ($5840). Brush 0: an arrow that points up and left.

- **Entry of:** [`brush_cursor_scripts`](../../tables.md#brush_cursor_scripts)

<a id="brush_cursor_1"></a>
### [`brush_cursor_1`](../../../../src/script/cursor_scripts.asm#L21) `$1B33-$1B40`

*data*
